newsitem.title: FRANCE: BMW sees eight pct 96 brand sales growth.
newsitem.headline: BMW sees eight pct 96 brand sales growth.

text.p: German luxury carmaker BMW AG said on Tuesday that it expected BMW brand sales growth in 1996 to be eight percent.

The carmaker also said that currency movements would be earnings-neutral in 1996. In an interview with Reuters, BMW management board member Bernd Pischetsrieder said: "Currency movements will be neutral, there is no negative effect."
Other German carmakers have expected the weaker mark to boost their results.
Earlier the group announced that its nine-month unit sales had grown by nine percent to 868,000 units.
The comments were made at the Paris car show.
